---
title: "GENCODE GFF3 named-attribute projections"
output: github_document
---

The source is the public GENCODE mouse vM25 BASIC GFF3, staged by
`scripts/stage_tabix_split.R --offline` from the `tabix_split_gff3` registry
artifact (24,025,067 compressed bytes; 1,299,172 annotation rows). Each query
streams the whole file in sequential mode. Measured outputs are scalar
aggregates of the stated columns, not `count(*)` shortcuts. Five measured runs
follow one warm-up per workload and thread setting. Times include gzip decode,
row scan, aggregation and R/DBI query execution. Default threads are the
runtime's own default; the GFF reader uses one worker in either setting.
The host is a 13th Gen Intel Core i5-13500 (20 logical CPUs) with two core
types, so the render records the CPU affinity of its process in the runs file
and compares with the previous render only on the same CPUs. Choose them with
`taskset -c`. `GFF_NAMED_SIZE=reduced` runs a driver check with one measured
run per cell, and writes its runs to a temporary file instead of
`benchmark_gff_named_attributes_runs.csv`; it is not a measurement.

``` sh
taskset -c 8-11 Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("benchmarks/benchmark_gff_named_attributes.Rmd")'
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r benchmark, include=FALSE}
Sys.setenv(DUCKHTSBENCH_REGISTRY = normalizePath(
  "r/duckhtsbench/inst/benchmark_registry.tsv", mustWork = TRUE
))
stopifnot(requireNamespace("duckhtsbench", quietly = TRUE))
stopifnot(requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE))
stopifnot(requireNamespace("DBI", quietly = TRUE))
stopifnot(requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE))
input <- duckhtsbench::duckhts_bench_artifact_path("tabix_split_gff3")
duckhtsbench::duckhts_bench_validate_identity("tabix_split_gff3", input)
input <- normalizePath(input, mustWork = TRUE)
extension <- normalizePath("build/release/duckhts.duckdb_extension", mustWork = TRUE)
size <- Sys.getenv("GFF_NAMED_SIZE", "full")
if (!size %in% c("full", "reduced")) stop("GFF_NAMED_SIZE must be full or reduced")
full_size <- identical(size, "full")
measured_runs_per_cell <- if (full_size) 5L else 1L
runs_path <- if (full_size) {
  "benchmarks/benchmark_gff_named_attributes_runs.csv"
} else {
  tempfile("gff-named-runs-", fileext = ".csv")
}
# The CPUs this process may run on, as taskset prints them; DuckDB's threads
# inherit the mask.
affinity_line <- system2("taskset", c("-pc", Sys.getpid()), stdout = TRUE)
affinity <- sub("^.*: *", "", affinity_line[[length(affinity_line)]])
host_load <- sub(".*load average: ", "", system2("uptime", stdout = TRUE))
quote_sql <- function(value) paste0("'", gsub("'", "''", value, fixed = TRUE), "'")
revision <- system2("git", c("rev-parse", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE)
if (system2("git", c("diff", "--quiet", "HEAD", "--", "src"),
            stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE) != 0L) {
  stop("Build source must match the recorded HEAD")
}
driver <- duckdb::duckdb(shared_home = FALSE, config = list(allow_unsigned_extensions = "true"))
con <- DBI::dbConnect(driver)
DBI::dbExecute(con, paste("LOAD", quote_sql(extension)))
default_threads <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT current_setting('threads')::INTEGER AS n")$n[[1L]]
source_sql <- paste0("read_gff(", quote_sql(input), ", scan_mode := 'sequential'")
plain <- paste0(source_sql, ")")
named <- paste0(source_sql, ", attributes := ['Parent', 'ID', 'gene_type'])")
map <- paste0(source_sql, ", attributes_map := true)")
queries <- c(
  plain_columns = paste0("SELECT count(*) n, sum(start + \"end\") metric FROM ", plain),
  named_none_projected = paste0("SELECT count(*) n, sum(start + \"end\") metric FROM ", named),
  attributes_string = paste0("SELECT count(*) n, sum(length(attributes)) metric FROM ", plain),
  map_parent = paste0("SELECT count(*) n, count(attributes_map['Parent']) metric FROM ", map),
  regexp_three = paste0("SELECT count(*) n, sum(length(regexp_extract(attributes, '(?:^|;)Parent=([^;]*)', 1)) + length(regexp_extract(attributes, '(?:^|;)ID=([^;]*)', 1)) + length(regexp_extract(attributes, '(?:^|;)gene_type=([^;]*)', 1))) metric FROM ", plain),
  named_three = paste0("SELECT count(*) n, sum(length(coalesce(Parent, '')) + length(coalesce(ID, '')) + length(coalesce(gene_type, ''))) metric FROM ", named),
  named_one_projected = paste0("SELECT count(*) n, sum(length(coalesce(Parent, ''))) metric FROM ", named)
)
rows <- list()
measured_runs <- list()
for (threads in c(1L, default_threads)) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("SET threads = ", threads))
  for (kind in names(queries)) {
    sql <- queries[[kind]]
    invisible(DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sql))
    elapsed <- numeric(measured_runs_per_cell)
    result <- NULL
    for (run in seq_along(elapsed)) {
      start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
      result <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sql)
      elapsed[[run]] <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - start
    }
    stopifnot(identical(as.numeric(result$n[[1L]]), 1299172))
    thread_label <- if (threads == 1L) "1" else paste0("default (", threads, ")")
    measured_runs[[length(measured_runs) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      threads = thread_label, workload = kind, run = seq_along(elapsed),
      seconds = elapsed, input_rows = result$n[[1L]], output_rows = 1L,
      metric = as.character(result$metric[[1L]]), affinity = affinity
    )
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      threads = thread_label,
      workload = kind, input_rows = result$n[[1L]],
      output_rows = 1L, metric = as.character(result$metric[[1L]]),
      median_seconds = median(elapsed), runs = length(elapsed)
    )
  }
}
results <- do.call(rbind, rows)
stopifnot(identical(results$workload, rep(names(queries), 2L)))
runs <- do.call(rbind, measured_runs)
write.csv(runs, runs_path, row.names = FALSE)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

`r if (!full_size) "**Reduced driver check (GFF_NAMED_SIZE=reduced): one measured run per cell, not a measurement.**"`

Source revision: `r revision`. DuckDB runtime: `r as.character(packageVersion("duckdb"))`.
Host load before the run: `r host_load`. CPU affinity: `r affinity`.
Extension SHA-256: `r strsplit(system2("sha256sum", extension, stdout = TRUE), " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]][[1L]]`.
Input SHA-256: `r strsplit(system2("sha256sum", input, stdout = TRUE), " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]][[1L]]`.

```{r results, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(results, digits = 3)
```

The one-key projection requests three keys at bind but scans only `Parent`.
`named_none_projected` requests three keys at bind but reads only the physical
coordinate columns; its scan skips attribute parsing entirely. Comparisons across
workloads reflect different aggregation and expression costs, not isolated
parsing cycles. `make wasm-playwright-test` built the extension from this
checkout for duckdb-wasm 1.31.0; all six Chromium tests passed, including
`test/wasm/gff-attributes.spec.ts`. Browser wasm timings were not measured.

## Change from the previous render

```{r previous, echo=FALSE}
# The previous render of this report, read from git: the same queries and
# input. Since then the attributes_map rows are written through one shared
# MAP helper that also checks each key is valid UTF-8; only map_parent builds
# the MAP. The host mixes core types, so the comparison needs the same CPUs.
previous_revision <- "60b36911"
previous_text <- system2("git", c("show", paste0(previous_revision,
                                                  ":benchmarks/benchmark_gff_named_attributes_runs.csv")),
                         stdout = TRUE)
stopifnot(is.null(attr(previous_text, "status")))
previous_runs <- utils::read.csv(text = previous_text, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
previous_affinity <- if ("affinity" %in% names(previous_runs)) unique(as.character(previous_runs$affinity)) else NULL
if (!is.null(previous_affinity) && !identical(previous_affinity, affinity)) {
  stop("The previous render ran on CPUs ", paste(previous_affinity, collapse = ", "),
       " and this one on CPUs ", affinity, "; render with taskset -c ", previous_affinity[[1L]])
}
# The default thread count is part of the label; compare by setting.
thread_setting <- function(label) ifelse(label == "1", "1", "default")
previous_runs$setting <- thread_setting(previous_runs$threads)
runs$setting <- thread_setting(runs$threads)
previous <- merge(aggregate(seconds ~ setting + workload, previous_runs, median),
                  aggregate(seconds ~ setting + workload, runs, median),
                  by = c("setting", "workload"), suffixes = c("_before", "_after"))
stopifnot(nrow(previous) == nrow(results))
previous$time_ratio <- previous$seconds_after / previous$seconds_before
previous <- previous[order(previous$setting, match(previous$workload, names(queries))), ]
rownames(previous) <- NULL
cpu_note <- if (is.null(previous_affinity)) {
  "The previous render recorded no CPU affinity, so the CPUs it ran on are unknown and the ratios may include a change of core type."
} else {
  paste0("Both renders ran on CPUs ", affinity, ".")
}
```

The previous render, `r previous_revision`, ran the same queries on the same
input with the same driver and host. `r cpu_note` Host load differs between
renders. Median seconds per cell:

```{r previous_table, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(previous, digits = 3)
```
